description: Creates a new version whose files equal a retained version, without uploading those files again. Inputs: slug, version, optional expected_version, and token. When expected_version does not match the live version, the result is version_conflict and nothing is written. The previous permalink keeps serving until retention drops it.

expected_version.description: Live version this restore is based on, such as "v4". A mismatch returns version_conflict.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

version.description: Version to copy forward, such as "v2".

name: restore_version
title: Restore a retained version
